newLesson: ROOT CAUSE: cleanup steps in a single linear finally form a chain—an error in early temp cleanup stops the critical lock release, producing a false busy state. FIX: nested finally reserves the lock-release attempt for every safe commit/rollback exit, while unpinned temps are never deleted. PROOF: injected missing-pin and PermissionError cases RED for original and GREEN in isolated Python model. PREVENTION: prioritize exclusive resource-release ordering; introduce a full-module owned-path regression only after the owner lock explicitly allows its path.
